name: Douguya ni Suiminkan Sareru Shota Yuusha
original_name: 道具屋に睡眠姦されるショタ勇者
source:
A shota adventurer is offered some new medicine by the owner of the item shop he frequents. However, after he tries it, he falls asleep, and gets dragged to bed by the owner.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ291669.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
正田冒险家经常光顾的物品商店的店主向他提供了一些新药。然而，当他尝试之后，他睡着了，被主人拖到床上。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ291669.html]DLsite[/url]]
